title: Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) Self-Pay Payoff Amount
content:
**Clause.** The self-pay balance standing is the Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) account's patient balance immediately before the payment. The self-pay payoff discount is the patient class's prompt-pay discount percent (from the prompt-pay terms) of the self-pay balance standing, rounded half-up to the cent, and the self-pay payoff amount is the self-pay balance standing less that discount.

**Combination.** Percentage points and dollar credits are combined with that figure this way: every allowance stated in percentage points is added to the self-pay payoff discount percent, the combined percent is applied once to the self-pay balance standing and rounded half-up to the cent, every credit stated in dollars is then subtracted from the self-pay balance standing together with that discount, and the self-pay payoff amount is never below 0.00.

## Condition, judgement, result (hypothetical inputs)

| Self-pay balance standing | Discount percent | Discount | Dollar credits | Payoff amount |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2000.00 | 15 | 300.00 | none | 1700.00 |
| 2000.00 | 17.5 | 350.00 | 20.00 | 1630.00 |
| 640.00 | 10 | 64.00 | none | 576.00 |

The balance standing is read as the account stands at the moment of payment, after every discount, adjustment and payment already posted on it.
